game.title: Ohvalhu Gondi (Game of Eight Holes)
game.description: A traditional mancala-style game played on a wooden board with eight holes on each side. Players distribute cowrie shells or pebbles, trying to accumulate the most in their home hole.
equipment: Wooden board with 16 holes (8 per side)
howToPlay: Step 1: Each player sits on opposite sides of the board.
Step 2: Fill each of the 8 holes with an equal number of shells.
Step 3: Players take turns picking up all shells from one hole on their side.
Step 4: Distribute one shell in each subsequent hole counterclockwise.
Step 5: Skip opponent's home hole but include your own home hole.
Step 6: If last shell lands in your home hole, you get another turn.
Step 7: If last shell lands in an empty hole on your side, capture opponent's opposite hole shells.
Step 8: Game continues until all holes are empty.
Step 9: Player with most shells in their home hole wins.
Step 10: In villages, boards were drawn on beach sand using coconut shells.
